description: West African Power Pool (WAPP) grid operating margin CO2 emission factor, applicable to Nigeria as a WAPP member country
source_title: Standardized Baseline for WAPP including Nigeria (ASB0034-2021)
methodology_note: Operating margin extracted directly from ASB0034-2021 Table 1 as 0.578 tCO2/MWh. Unit conversion to kgCO2e/kWh is 1:1 because 1 tCO2/MWh equals 1 kgCO2/kWh. The OM is a 2017-2019 generation-weighted average using the simple operating margin method; low-cost/must-run generation was below 50% of total generation.

description: West African Power Pool (WAPP) grid build margin CO2 emission factor, applicable to Nigeria as a WAPP member country
source_title: Standardized Baseline for WAPP including Nigeria (ASB0034-2021)
methodology_note: Build margin extracted directly from ASB0034-2021 Table 1 as 0.556 tCO2/MWh. Unit conversion to kgCO2e/kWh is 1:1. The BM represents the most-recent dispatchable capacity additions (2015-2019) comprising the 20% generation sample set, using 2019 generation data.

description: West African Power Pool (WAPP) grid combined margin CO2 emission factor for wind and solar power generation project activities, first crediting period
source_title: Standardized Baseline for WAPP including Nigeria (ASB0034-2021)
methodology_note: Combined margin extracted from ASB0034-2021 Table 1 as 0.573 tCO2/MWh for wind/solar project activities. Cross-check with TOOL07: CM = OM x 0.75 + BM x 0.25 = 0.578 x 0.75 + 0.556 x 0.25 = 0.5725, rounded to 0.573 tCO2/MWh. The general/other-projects first-crediting-period value is 0.567 tCO2/MWh (50/50 weights). Unit conversion to kgCO2e/kWh is 1:1.

description: Nigeria national grid location-based Scope 2 emission factor derived from 2020 Energy Databank plant generation records and IPCC 2006 default stationary-combustion factors. Represents NEFDB Phase 1.
source_title: Nigerian Energy Data Bank - Power Plant Generation Statistics
source_publisher: Federal Ministry of Energy / Energy Data Bank
methodology_note: Derived from generation-by-fuel data for 2020 (gas 7,281.71 GWh, hydro 75.59 GWh; all other fuels zero). Fuel input energy = generation x 3.6 TJ/GWh / thermal efficiency (35% assumed for gas). Emissions = fuel input x IPCC Table 2.2 CO2/CH4/N2O factors; CH4 and N2O converted using AR6 GWP (28 and 265). Hydro/solar/wind are zero-emission. The dataset under-represents national hydro because Kainji/Jebba/Shiroro 2020 records use non-MWh units and are excluded.

description: DisCo-level location-based grid emission factor for AEDC based on Q2 2024 billed energy and a 2020-derived regional generation mix.
methodology_note: Derived by applying a 70% gas / 30% hydro regional generation mix to AEDC Q2 2024 billed energy (301.000 GWh) and IPCC 2006 stationary-combustion EFs for natural gas. Oil, solar and other generation are treated as zero in Phase 1. Hydro share reflects DisCo territory proximity to Kainji/Jebba/Shiroro hydro vs Niger Delta/IPP gas plants. The underlying energy-databank plant-level hydro records for 2020 are incomplete (large hydro excluded due to non-MWh units), so NERC-reported hydro shares were used to anchor regional assumptions. EF does not include T&D losses or upstream gas fugitive emissions.
